data.name: Nahrawan
data.gender_notes: Nahrawan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nahrawan is a name that refers to a river in Paradise, symbolizing peace and serenity. It is a name that evokes a sense of calmness and tranquility. The name Nahrawan carries the meaning “River in Paradise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nahrawan usually hope their child will grow to embody river in paradise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Nahrawan is mentioned in the Quran as one of the rivers in Paradise, making it a spiritually significant name.
data.etymology: Nahrawan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “River in Paradise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nahrawan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: نهراوان
in_arabic.meaning: مكان مشهور بنهر عظيم يسمى نهراوان في العراق
in_arabic.long_meaning: نهراوان هو اسم مكان مشهور بنهر عظيم يسمى نهراوان في العراق، ويعتبر من الأسماء الجغرافية التي تحمل دلالة المكان والتراث. ويرتبط هذا الاسم بتاريخ وحضارة العراق القديمة.

in_urdu.name: نہروان
in_urdu.meaning: ایک مشہور مقام جس میں ایک بڑا دریا ہے نهراوان ، عراق میں واقع ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: نہروان ایک جغرافیائی نام ہے جو عراق میں ایک مشہور مقام سے منسوب ہے جہاں ایک بڑا دریا ہے۔ اس کا تعلق عراق کی قدیم تاریخ اور تہذیب سے ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नहरावान
in_hindi.meaning: एक प्रसिद्ध स्थान जिसमें एक बड़ी नदी है नहरावान, इराक में स्थित है
in_hindi.long_meaning: नहरावान एक भौगोलिक नाम है जो इराक में एक प्रसिद्ध स्थान से जुड़ा है जहां एक बड़ी नदी है। इसका संबंध इराक के प्राचीन इतिहास और सभ्यता से है।

in_pashto.name: نهراوان
in_pashto.meaning: یو مشهور ځای چی په عراق کیو یوه لویه سیندره لری نهراوان
in_pashto.long_meaning: نهراوان یو جغرافي نوم دی چی عراق میں یو مشهور ځای سره تړلی دی چیرته یوه لویه سیندره شته. دا نوم د عراق د پخواني تاريخ او تمدن سره تړاو لري.

in_english.name: Nahrawan
in_english.meaning: A famous place with a great river Nahrawan in Iraq
in_english.long_meaning: Nahrawan is a toponymic name referring to a famous place in Iraq where a great river by the same name is located. The name has its roots in Arabic and is associated with the ancient history and civilization of Mesopotamia. The river Nahrawan is a significant geographical feature in Iraq's landscape.

data.cultural_impact: Nahrawan holds significant cultural importance in Islamic history. It is mentioned in various hadiths (sayings of the prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him) as one of the many rivers in Paradise. This name is often used as a symbol of peace, serenity, and tranquility within Islamic and Arabic literature, poetry, and art.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic theology, the name Nahrawan represents a deeper spiritual meaning. It is an allusion to the river that flows in Paradise, where the faithful will drink from and be refreshed after their long journey in the world. The name reminds Muslims of the promise of eternal peace and serenity in the afterlife, and serves as a source of comfort and motivation for believers to endure the hardships of life and strive towards righteousness.

historical_references.reference: The Battle of Nahrawan took place in 651 AD between the forces of the Islamic caliphate, led by Ali ibn Abi Talib, and the Byzantine Empire, led by the Byzantine general, Heraclius.
historical_references.context: The battle is considered a significant event in Islamic history as it marked the end of the Byzantine threat to the Islamic caliphate and solidified Ali's position as the fourth caliph of Islam.
